issues.title: Rebrand: Finalize email domain standard (folkcare.example vs folk.care)
issues.body:
## Priority: P1 - Rebranding

## Description
Standardize email domains across codebase.

## Current Inconsistency
- Some use: `admin@folkcare.example`
- Some use: `admin@folk.care`
- Some use: `admin@tx.folkcare.example`

## Decision Needed
Choose one standard:
- **Option A**: `admin@folk.care` (production domain)
- **Option B**: `admin@folkcare.example` (RFC 2606 reserved)
- **Option C**: `admin@demo.folk.care` (subdomain)

## Files Affected
- `packages/web/src/app/pages/Login.tsx`
- `README.md`
- Database seed files
- Documentation

## Related
- Issue #550

issues.title: Performance: Optimize Mobile App Bundle Size
issues.body:
## Priority: P4 - Performance

## Description
Reduce React Native app size.

## Tasks
- [ ] Remove unused dependencies
- [ ] Enable Hermes (if not already)
- [ ] Optimize assets
- [ ] Use ProGuard (Android)
- [ ] App thinning (iOS)

- Android: <30MB
- iOS: <25MB

Faster downloads, better for low-storage devices.

issues.title: Performance: Add Database Read Replicas
issues.body:
## Priority: P4 - Performance

## Description
Use read replicas for reporting and analytics.

## Implementation
- Neon supports read replicas
- Route SELECT queries to replica
- Route write queries to primary

## Why Important
Reduce load on primary database.

issues.title: Monitoring: Add Custom Health Check Endpoint
issues.body:
## Priority: P5 - Monitoring

## Description
Comprehensive health check for monitoring.

## Checks
- Database connectivity
- Redis connectivity
- API responsiveness
- Disk space
- Memory usage

## Endpoint
`GET /health`

Returns:
```json
{
  "status": "healthy",
  "checks": {
    "database": "ok",
    "redis": "ok",
    "api": "ok"
  }
}
```

## Why Important
Detailed system status for monitoring tools.

issues.title: Monitoring: Add Performance Budget for Frontend
issues.body:
## Priority: P5 - Monitoring

## Description
Set and enforce performance budgets.

## Budgets
- Bundle size: <200KB gzipped
- Time to interactive: <3s
- Largest Contentful Paint: <2.5s
- First Input Delay: <100ms
- Cumulative Layout Shift: <0.1

## Enforcement
- Fail CI if budget exceeded
- Report in PR comments

## Why Important
Prevent performance regressions.

issues.title: DevOps: Add Blue-Green Deployment Strategy
issues.body:
## Priority: P6 - DevOps

## Description

## Implementation
- Vercel preview deployments
- Promote to production after validation
- Instant rollback capability

## Why Important
Reduce deployment risk.

issues.title: DevOps: Add Database Backup Verification Automation
issues.body:
## Priority: P6 - DevOps

## Description
Automatically verify backups are restorable.

## Process
1. Create test database
2. Restore from latest backup
3. Run validation queries
4. Cleanup test database
5. Alert if verification fails

## Schedule
- Weekly verification

## Why Important
Backups are useless if they can't be restored.
